rulesTestNames: lets managers read live guest and settings views and nothing else
owner: Live guest and settings view evaluator: hostReadModels guest view triggers
read: current organizer managers get their own organizer's views by id; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; one per attendee of an event with an eventFormat and an endTime, deleted with the attendee or the event
migrationNotes: ready is evaluated one millisecond before eventEndAtMillis; the phone ANDs it with the app clock, re-derives a pending transfer's state from transfer.expiresAt and the actions for the signed-in manager.
receivers keep their uncapped authority instants; the phone caps them to the handover review it opens (thirty minutes, at most the event end).
